visible_condition: stacked in a container or warehouse
hidden_risks: Actual quality and grade of clothes inside the sealed bales
Presence of damaged, stained, or unsellable items
Exact weight and volume of the contents
Actual mix of styles and sizes
response.best_proof: A photo showing an opened bale with the interior garments laid out for inspection
response.failure_mode: Assuming uniform high quality (Grade A) of the contents based entirely on exterior packaging and labels without verifying the interior items.
